Subject: Interested in Private/VPC demo (self-serve signup)

Hi team,

We just completed the self-serve signup on your site and selected the Private/VPC option for evaluation. I'm Jordan (IT lead at AcmeHealth). We're evaluating solutions for a regulated workload (HIPAA) and would like a product demo focused on Private deployment, VPC connectivity, key management (KMS/HSM), and audit logs.

Key questions up front:
- Does Redwood support customer-managed KMS and HSM options?
- Can you demo network topology options for VPC peering vs. AWS PrivateLink?
- Do you have an on-prem installer for air-gapped environments or only cloud VPC?

We'd like to get a live demo next week if possible. My availability is generally afternoons (ET). I'll include Tom (infrastructure) and a security contact on follow-ups.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee

Thanks Jordan — confirming Wed 7/7 at 3:00pm ET. I've sent a calendar invite to you and Tom; please accept when convenient. We've looped in Nikhil (Account Exec) and Lauren (Solutions Engineer) to cover procurement, network topology, KMS/HSM options, and on-prem feasibility.

Quick answers to your questions:
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) today. HSM-based key custody for on-prem deployments is supported via our private deployment options; we'll cover specific patterns in the demo and share a compliance packet afterwards.
- Networking: We support VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, and connector-based VPNs. Lauren will walk through topology diagrams and recommended architectures based on latency and security needs.
- On-prem: We offer an on-prem package for regulated customers. It's not the default self-serve flow, but we have an air-gapped installer and validated deployment patterns for customers with strict data residency requirements.

Attached is a short checklist to help your infra/security team prepare for the call (private-vpc-checklist.xlsx). We'll also share a Drive folder with architecture docs in the invite.

Next steps: please confirm Tom and your security contact; we'll update the invite with a meeting agenda.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
